[[Talk Like a Pirate Day]] |rewards = {{RewardsList|Insane|Modifiers = 1.1|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} }} ==Description== '''Black Spot Exchange''' is an {{Color|Insane}} [[Maps|map]] with two paths, both of which are quite short. It takes place on a grass isle surrounded by two ships. '''Black Spot Exchange''' has the [[All Paths]] and [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]] modifiers. The [[All Paths]] modifier duplicates all enemies for each path with the exception of major bosses, instead of them alternating between entrances. [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]] modifier adds pirate hat onto every enemy. The [[All Paths]] modifier increases all currency rewards by 10%. ==Design & Path== '''Black Spot Exchange''' takes place on a tropical isle, with several small cliffs, crates, palm trees and a buried treasure around the isle. It neighbors the cliffs and a large cave with a large rock above it carved to look like a skull. Wooden docks can also be found inside of the cave. Two abandoned ships neighbor the island; the right ship is a dilapidated pirate ship that appears to be a ghost ship. It has several green ghosts on it and its windows are glowing green. The left ship is a regular ship painted blue. The two paths start at the ships, one path on the left ship and the other on the right ship, and then end at the opposite ship. The paths itself are identical, except they start and end at different ships. ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Black Spot Exchange}} ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. {{Rewards|Insane|Modifiers = 1.1|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} ==Strategy== *Because of the [[All Paths]] modifier, every enemy except major bosses spawn twice. **Because of this, area of effect towers like the [[Assassin]], [[Mortar]], [[Golden Pyromancer]] or [[Rocketeer]] can be useful here. ***They are especially useful as both of the paths fully intersect with each other. *Towers that spawn units, such as the [[Military Base]] may be ineffective here, as both exits on this map are also entrances, making units collide with enemies almost instantly. **The map is also quite short, reducing how long the unit can be on the map even if it survived and reached the entrance. *This map has good spots to place [[Ace Pilot]]s and [[Pursuit]]s, due to nearly all of it being made up of wide turns that allow those towers to have their flight paths align with the enemies. *If placed near the middle, cliff towers are able to cover most of the path, making them useful here. **However, do note that cliff spots are limited there. *Due to its large placement footprint, the [[Turret]] is generally not recommended. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} St Patricks Crate - Tower Defense Simulator|Current version on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Summer Battlepass - Tower Defense Simulator|Current version in the game trailer. St Patricks Crate - Tower Defense Simulator|Current version in the game trailer. }} ==Trivia== *The map is named after a [[wp:Black Spot (Treasure Island)|Black Spot]]. It is a literary device invented by [[wp:Robert Louis Stevenson|Robert Louis Stevenson]] for the novel [[wp:Treasure Island|Treasure Island]]. **[[wp:Black Spot (Treasure Island)|Black Spot]] was a piece of paper or card that had one side blackened and the other side having a message. It was used to officially pronounce a verdict of guilt or judgement by being placed in the hand of the accused in the novel. *The ghost ship present on this map is a reference to the [[wp:Flying Dutchman|Flying Dutchman]]. *The skull that appears above the cave is the {{RLinkC|4765718|The Riddling Skull}} from the Roblox catalog. *This is the only map to have two paths fully intersect each other. ==Update History== *'''5 August 2023''' - [[v1.8.4]] **'''Black Spot Exchange''' added. *'''22 September 2023''' - [[v1.8.5]] **{{Bug}} '''Black Spot Exchange''' is no longer in the game. *'''25 September 2023''' - [[v1.8.5]]b **{{Bugfix}} '''Black Spot Exchange''' is in the game again. *'''22 March 2024''' - [[v1.16.0]]e **Made playable in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. *'''22 January 2025''' - [[v1.50.0]] **{{Bug}} Only the water loads in. *'''31 January 2025''' - [[v1.51.0|v1.51.1]] **[[Enemies Beta]] removed. **{{Bugfix}} The entire map now loads in. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **No longer playable in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. {{MapNavBox}}
